canonical_passage: But the one who dwells in the wilderness for the sake of having few wishes is the foremost, best, chief, highest, and finest of the five.
context_summary: The sutta discusses different types of wilderness dwellers, emphasizing the value of simplicity and having few desires.
problem_summary: Many people struggle with excessive desires and the complications they bring to life, leading to dissatisfaction and stress.
diagnosis: Excessive desires can lead to a complicated and unfulfilled life.
teaching: Living with fewer wishes leads to greater contentment and fulfillment.
practice_actions: Identify and reduce unnecessary desires in your life.
Practice gratitude for what you have instead of focusing on what you lack.
Engage in simple living practices, such as decluttering your space or simplifying your schedule.

canonical_passage: But the person who eats only from the almsbowl for the sake of having few wishes is the foremost, best, chief, highest, and finest of the five.
context_summary: The sutta discusses the motivations behind why some individuals choose to eat only from the almsbowl, highlighting the importance of having few desires.
problem_summary: Many people struggle with excessive desires and cravings, leading to dissatisfaction and a lack of contentment in life.
diagnosis: Excessive desires can lead to unhappiness and a sense of lack.
teaching: Cultivating contentment and reducing desires can lead to a more fulfilling and peaceful life.
practice_actions: Reflect on your current desires and identify which ones are essential and which are not.
Practice gratitude for what you have, focusing on contentment rather than wanting more.
Set small, achievable goals to reduce unnecessary cravings in daily life.
